'''Business and economy'''
*[[United States embargo against Cuba]]
**[[Air Canada]] suspends all flights to [[Cuba]] and deploys empty aircraft to repatriate stranded passengers after the country's fuel supply was exhausted due to the [[U.S.]] [[blockade]] and the end of [[Energy in Venezuela|fuel supplies]] from [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/cuba-warns-airlines-it-will-run-out-jet-fuel-2026-02-09/ (Reuters)]
**[[Mexico]] deploys two [[Mexican Navy|navy]] vessels, including the [[USS Newport (LST-1179)|ARM ''Papaloapan'']], carrying more than 800 tonnes of [[humanitarian aid]] to Cuba amid critical [[shortage]]s on the island. [https://mexiconewsdaily.com/news/mexico-aid-to-cuba/ (Mexico News Daily)]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Cuba)|Cuban foreign minister]] [[Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla]] condemns the ongoing U.S. blockade as "cruel", accusing [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] of trying to "break the political will" of the [[Cubans|Cuban people]]. [[Russia]] also calls for an immediate end to the blockade to avoid a [[humanitarian crisis]], and says it will explore ways to help the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/10/russia-warns-cuba-fuel-situation-critical-as-havana-slams-cruel-us-tactic (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Armenia–United States relations]]
**[[Armenia–Azerbaijan peace agreement]]
***[[United States]] [[Vice President of the United States|vice president]] [[JD Vance]] visits [[Armenia]], becoming the highest ranking U.S. official to have visited Armenia in [[History of Armenia|its history]]. Vance meets with [[Prime Minister of Armenia|prime minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]] to discuss implementing a [[Armenia–Azerbaijan peace agreement|peace agreement]] to end the [[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-vance-armenia-azerbaijan-69a04efaea7e62994d3a749bb2bf27fc (AP)]
**Armenia and the United States reach a nuclear deal, outlining a [[Section 123 Agreement]] and up to [[United States dollar|US$]]9 billion in total [[List of exports of the United States|exports]] to Armenia related to [[Nuclear energy policy of the United States|nuclear energy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-vice-president-vance-heads-armenia-azerbaijan-push-peace-trade-2026-02-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Allied Command Transformation]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces]] announces the transfer of two major [[NATO]] [[command and control]] centres over to [[Europe]]an military forces in [[Naples]], [[Italy]], and [[Norfolk, Virginia|Norfolk]], [[Virginia]], as part of a gradual shift to European countries taking a leading role in the [[military alliance]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-turn-over-2-nato-command-posts-europeans-military-source-says-2026-02-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Australia–Israel relations]], [[Gaza war protests in Australia]]
**Protests against [[Israel]]i [[President of Israel|president]] [[Isaac Herzog]]'s [[state visit]], following the [[2025 Bondi Beach shooting]], are held in cities across [[Australia]]. In [[Sydney]], protests occurred amid a ban by the [[Government of New South Wales|state government]] on [[Hate speech laws in Australia|hate speech]] grounds, resulting in [[NSW Police|police]] making 27 arrests and deploying [[pepper spray]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-02-09/crowds-protest-israeli-president-isaac-herzog-in-australia/106321716 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025–2026 Iranian protests]]
**[[Iran]]ian [[Police Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran|police]] arrest several senior figures from the [[Reformists Front]], including [[Mohsen Aminzadeh]], [[Ebrahim Asgharzadeh]], and [[Azar Mansouri]], while additional members receive [[summons]]es to appear before prosecutors, with no formal charges publicly disclosed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/iran-arrests-least-four-reform-front-politicians-2026-02-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 political prisoner release in Venezuela]]
**The [[Public Ministry of Venezuela]] says [[Juan Pablo Guanipa]], who was released and later abducted on Sunday, broke his [[parole]]'s terms and that a request has been made to place Guanipa under [[house arrest]], while not specifying if the government has him in custody. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuelan-politician-juan-pablo-guanipa-kidnapped-after-being-freed-prisoner-2026-02-09/ (Reuters)]
*''[[HKSAR v Lai Chee Ying & Others]]''
**[[Hong Kong]] opposition figure [[Jimmy Lai]] is sentenced to 20 years in [[Prisons in Hong Kong|prison]] for violating a [[2020 Hong Kong national security law|national security law]] following a two-year trial. Eight others, including six former ''[[Apple Daily]]'' executives and two [[Pro-democracy camp (Hong Kong)|pro-democracy]] activists, are also sentenced to more than 10 years in prison. [https://hongkongfp.com/2026/02/09/breaking-jimmy-lai-jailed-for-20-years-in-hong-kong-after-nat-security-conviction/ (HKFP)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/after-years-long-legal-battle-hong-kong-media-tycoon-jimmy-lai-arrives-day-2026-02-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Missing persons in Mexico]]
**The bodies of three employees abducted from a [[Mining in Mexico|mining]] facility in [[Sinaloa]], [[Mexico]], are recovered after being taken on January 23, while authorities continue searching for the remaining seven missing workers. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260209-three-missing-employees-of-canadian-miner-found-dead-in-mexico (AFP via France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Immigration to Sweden]]
**[[Sweden|Swedish]] [[Minister for Migration (Sweden)|migration minister]] [[Johan Forssell (politician, born 1979)|Johan Forssell]] announces the implementation of stricter [[Swedish nationality law|naturalization requirements]] from June 6, extending the [[Permanent residency|residency]] period from five years to eight, imposing a minimum income threshold of 20,000 [[Swedish krona|kr]] ([[United States dollar|US$]]2,225), requiring [[Swedish language|language]] and [[Citizenship test|civic knowledge tests]], and lengthening waiting times for applicants with criminal records. [https://www.reuters.com/world/sweden-tighten-citizenship-rules-amid-push-cut-immigration-2026-02-09/ (Reuters)]
